bibl.title: One Week in January: A Register of Men from Late Antique Egypt.
bibl.seg: 141.13 P. Mich. Inv. 1545 145.13 P. Brux. Baouît 33
Jennifer Cromwell, One Week in January: A Register of Men from Late Antique Egypt.
bibl.note: P. Mich. Inv. 1545: a Coptic daybook registering men, possibly visitors to the monastery of Apa Apollo at Bawit, seventh / eighth century. - Corrections to P. Brux. Baouît 33.
